versions.description: Kill/Death Tracker — tracks player kills, deaths, and points with streaks, leaderboards, and seasonal resets.
versions.configSchema: {"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"object","properties":{"pvpKillPoints":{"type":"number","default":10,"minimum":0,"description":"Points awarded for killing another player"},"mobKillPoints":{"type":"number","default":1,"minimum":0,"description":"Points awarded for killing a mob or entity"},"deathPenalty":{"type":"number","default":5,"minimum":0,"description":"Points deducted on death (floored at 0)"},"streakBonusInterval":{"type":"number","default":5,"minimum":1,"description":"Every N kills awards bonus points (see streakBonusPoints)"},"streakBonusPoints":{"type":"number","default":25,"minimum":0,"description":"Bonus points awarded at each streak milestone"},"streakBroadcast":{"type":"boolean","default":true,"description":"Broadcast streak milestones to the server"},"streakResetOnDeath":{"type":"boolean","default":true,"description":"Reset current streak on death"},"awardCurrency":{"type":"boolean","default":false,"description":"Also grant Takaro currency equal to points earned"},"leaderboardPageSize":{"type":"number","default":10,"minimum":1,"maximum":25,"description":"Number of players per leaderboard page"},"killBroadcast":{"type":"boolean","default":false,"description":"Broadcast PvP kills to the server (mob kills are not broadcast)"}},"required":[],"additionalProperties":false}

commands.name: leaderboard
commands.helpText: View the top players ranked by points. Use /top [page] to browse pages.

commands.name: resetstats
commands.helpText: Admin command. Use /resetstats all to reset ALL stats and start a new season. Use /resetstats <player> to reset only that player's stats.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Player name to reset, or 'all' to reset all stats and start a new season.

commands.name: stats
commands.description: View your kill/death stats and rank
commands.helpText: View your personal kill stats, K/D ratio, points, streak, and current rank for the current season.

hooks.name: on-death
hooks.description: Track player deaths, apply death penalty, and attribute PvP kills to the attacker

hooks.name: on-kill
hooks.description: Track mob kills and award points when a player kills an entity

functions.name: tracker-helpers

permissions.description: Allows a player to view kill stats and leaderboard
Allows an admin to reset kill stats for a player or all players
Count = point multiplier for this player (e.g. count=2 means 2x points)
